lines.zh: 低吼前行，胃中消化着植物纤维
lines.en: Rumble as you walk, digesting plant fibers in your stomach

lines.zh: 挥动巨大身躯，寻找新的青草
lines.en: Swing your massive body, seeking fresh grass

lines.zh: 咕噜声中，胃中消化着纤维
lines.en: Gurgling as you digest fibers in your stomach

lines.zh: 用小小脑袋观察四周，寻找食物
lines.en: Use your tiny head to scan for food

lines.zh: 吞下植物纤维，慢慢消化
lines.en: Swallow plant fibers, slowly digesting them

lines.zh: 缓慢移动，消化着大量食物
lines.en: Move slowly, digesting a lot of food

lines.zh: 巨大的胃不断蠕动，消化纤维
lines.en: Your massive stomach churns, digesting fibers

lines.zh: 咀嚼着植物纤维，缓慢前进
lines.en: Chew on plant fibers, moving slowly forward

lines.zh: 消化完毕，继续寻找食物
lines.en: Finish digesting, continue searching for food

lines.zh: 低吼着，在森林中慢慢行进
lines.en: Rumble as you slowly move through the forest

lines.zh: 四条短腿撑起一大片肚子。
lines.en: Four stubby legs haul a huge belly.

lines.zh: 肚子贴地，一路刮过蕨叶。
lines.en: Its belly drags through the ferns.
One bite of cycad, one more step.
Three steps, then it stops to chew.
Lie still, basking in the sun
Scan your tiny head around
Your stomach gurgles, digesting food

lines.zh: 在阳光下打盹，享受片刻宁静
lines.en: Nap in the sun, enjoying a moment of peace
Chew slowly, digesting plants

lines.zh: 静静地躺着，享受午后时光
lines.en: Lie quietly, enjoying the afternoon
Digesting slowly, savoring

lines.zh: 用小脑袋观察，等待食物
lines.en: Scan your tiny head, waiting for food
Bask in the sun, digesting slowly
Lie in the sun, digesting slowly

lines.zh: 趴着反刍，喉咙一动一动。
lines.en: It lies chewing, throat bobbing.
It spreads its belly on a warm rock.

lines.zh: 小脑袋一点一点打瞌睡。
lines.en: Its tiny head nods off.
Its tail lazily sweeps the leaf litter.
Stare at you with tiny eyes
Rumble, noticing you
Slowly turn your head, observing you
Swing your body to look at you
Turn your tiny head to stare at you
Fix your tiny eyes on you

lines.zh: 低吼一声，注意到了玩家
lines.en: Rumble, noticing the player
Stare at the player with tiny eyes
Slowly turn your head to look at you
Observe the player, alertness rising
Its little eyes take a while to focus.
It lifts its head, grass still in its mouth.
My stomach hurts!
Ouch, my wings!
Such a big stone!
Such a small cave!
Do not slap my back; my hide is thin.

lines.zh: 肚子贴着地，我饿得发慌。
lines.en: Belly to the ground, I am frantic with hunger.

lines.zh: 大肚子撞到石头，骨头响了。
lines.en: My huge gut hit a rock — bones rattled.
I can't fly anymore!

lines.zh: 这地方没有蕨叶，我认不得路。
lines.en: There are no fern leaves here; I do not know the way.
This cave is too dark!

lines.zh: 贪吃的你，可要小心我庞大的身躯！
lines.en: Beware my massive body, greedy one!

lines.zh: 别以为肉少，我就不吃你！
lines.en: Think I won't eat you just because there's little meat?
My stomach can digest anything!
Come, taste the Cotylorhynchus!

lines.zh: 喝我的 grog，享受美妙时光！
lines.en: Drink my grog, enjoy the ride!
Don't be afraid, I only eat plants.

lines.zh: 用我的肉，做出美味佳肴吧！
lines.en: Use my meat to make delicious dishes!
My grog, effects amaze!
Your tiny fists won't hurt me!

lines.zh: 我的胃能吃尽一切植物！
lines.en: My stomach can digest all plants!
Watch out, my head撞ed you!

lines.zh: 我的体型，不是闹着玩的！
lines.en: My size is no joke!

lines.zh: 我这张大肚子，比城墙还宽。
lines.en: My big belly is wider than a wall.
You're too light to defeat me!

lines.zh: 我的体型，就是我的武器！
lines.en: My size is my weapon!
Feel the power with my body!

lines.zh: 我的体型，比你想象的更恐怖！
lines.en: My size is more terrifying than you think!

lines.zh: 我的体型，足以碾压一切！
lines.en: My size can crush anything!
Your attack is ineffective on me!

lines.zh: 我的体型，就是我的防御！
lines.en: My size is my defense!

lines.zh: 找我交配吧，强壮的生物！
lines.en: Mate with me, strong being!

lines.zh: 来吧，交配是我唯一的兴趣！
lines.en: Mate, it's my only interest!

lines.zh: 我的交配，保证让你满意！
lines.en: My mating will satisfy you!
Mate with me, I'll be gentle!

lines.zh: 我是交配的高手，来试试吧！
lines.en: I'm a mating master, give it a try!

lines.zh: 我的交配，让你难以忘怀！
lines.en: My mating is unforgettable!
Mate with me, let's reproduce!

lines.zh: 我是交配之王，你愿意吗？
lines.en: I'm the mating king, will you mate with me?

lines.zh: 找我交配，享受美妙时刻！
lines.en: Mate with me, enjoy the moment!
My mating is definitely worth it!

lines.zh: 你捡起了一块肥硕的杯龙肉。
lines.en: You picked up some hefty cupdrake meat.
Cupdrake meat, rich in flavor.
Beware, this meat might be poisonous.
The cupdrake's stomach is amazing.
Cupdrake meat is a perfect tonic.
Cupdrake meat is rare.
This cupdrake meat is still tender.
Cupdrake meat is great for soup.
This meat should still be fresh.
Cupdrake meat is nutritious.
Target acquired, preparing to capture.
The cupdrake's low growl.
Cupdrake, beware!
You've found a cupdrake.
Preparing to tame the cupdrake.

lines.zh: 杯龙的注意力被吸引了。
lines.en: The cupdrake's attention is drawn.
Cupdrake, your end is here.
The cupdrake is now noticing you.
The cupdrake is approaching.

lines.zh: 杯龙开始对你感兴趣了。
lines.en: The cupdrake is now interested in you.
You crushed a patch of ferns.
That grass in your hand smells good.
Don't touch my stomach.

lines.zh: 从蕨丛跟到河边，我一直看着你。
lines.en: From the ferns to the river, I have watched you.

lines.zh: 杯龙正在用它那小脑袋瞄准你。
lines.en: The cupdrake is aiming with its tiny head.

lines.zh: 杯龙用它那小脑袋看穿了你。
lines.en: The cupdrake sees through you with its tiny head.

lines.zh: 杯龙的小脑袋在思考对策。
lines.en: The cupdrake's tiny head is strategizing.

lines.zh: 杯龙的小脑袋里有你的影子。
lines.en: The cupdrake's tiny head has your silhouette.

lines.zh: 杯龙的小脑袋正在计算路径。
lines.en: The cupdrake's tiny head is calculating the path.

lines.zh: 杯龙的小脑袋正在寻找弱点。
lines.en: The cupdrake's tiny head is searching for weaknesses.

lines.zh: 杯龙的小脑袋在制定计划。
lines.en: The cupdrake's tiny head is making plans.

lines.zh: 杯龙的小脑袋在思考你的动作。
lines.en: The cupdrake's tiny head is pondering your actions.

lines.zh: 杯龙的小脑袋在寻找攻击机会。
lines.en: The cupdrake's tiny head is looking for an attack.

lines.zh: 杯龙的小脑袋已经锁定了目标。
lines.en: The cupdrake's tiny head has locked on to the target.
I'm working out how far you are.
My belly says hit first, think later.
You've backed up to the rocks.
One of my steps equals three of yours.

lines.zh: 小脑袋也记得你的味道。
lines.en: Even this small head recalls your smell.

lines.zh: 用头撞击，巨响震动山岩！
lines.en: Headbutt, shaking the rocks!

lines.zh: 小脑袋撞大石头，威力不小！
lines.en: Small head, big power on stone.
Gastric expansion, strength doubles.

lines.zh: 粗壮的尾巴甩动，激起尘土飞扬！
lines.en: Thick tail swishes, dust flying.
Bite hard, tearing apart.
Roar echoes through the hills.
Mouth wide, devouring all.
Wings flap, attacking targets.
Tail waves, scaring off enemies.
Body rolls, knocking down opponents.
The whole bulk comes down!
That shove will hurt.
My tail catches your knees.
I bump you with my belly.

lines.zh: 在森林深处醒来，寻找食物！
lines.en: Awake in the forest, seeking food.
Night falls, Cotylorhynchus awakens.

lines.zh: 在密林中穿梭，寻找伙伴！
lines.en: Navigating the dense woods, seeking companions.

lines.zh: 从洞穴中走出，迎接黎明！
lines.en: Emerging from caves, welcoming dawn.

lines.zh: 在平原边缘觅食，警惕四周！
lines.en: Feeding on the plains, watching all around.

lines.zh: 在沼泽旁休息，等待时机！
lines.en: Resting by the swamp, waiting for an opportunity.
Drinking by the river, enjoying the cool.

lines.zh: 在岩洞中休憩，静待猎物！
lines.en: Resting in the cave, waiting for prey.

lines.zh: 在树丛间徘徊，寻找果实！
lines.en: Wandering in the bushes, searching for fruits.

lines.zh: 在草地上漫步，享受清晨！
lines.en: Wandering on the grass, enjoying the morning.

lines.zh: 我从深板岩化石里复原。
lines.en: I'm restored from a deepslate fossil.

lines.zh: 培养器裂开，我爬了出来。
lines.en: The cultivator split and I crawled out.

lines.zh: 古生代的草还是这个味。
lines.en: Paleozoic grass still tastes the same.

lines.zh: 有机黏液还黏在我背上。
lines.en: Organic ooze still clings to my back.

lines.zh: 花了三管 DNA 才拼好我。
lines.en: It took three tubes of DNA to assemble me.

lines.zh: 这具身体比化石时胖了。
lines.en: This body is fatter than my fossil.

lines.zh: 杯子龙又回到地面上了。
lines.en: Cotylorhynchus walks the earth again.

lines.zh: 我先找片蕨类安顿下来。
lines.en: First I'll find some ferns to settle in.
My hide is scorched hot!
I flew too high!
There are clams in the water!
A blast hit my huge belly.
Something stuck in my back.
Magic hit me!

lines.zh: 这肚子消化得太快，又空了。
lines.en: This belly digests too fast and is empty again.
Lightning numbed my legs.
I flew out of the cave!
